biryani.health_tip: Pair biryani with raita and add salad to improve balance and portion control.

burger.health_tip: Choose grilled patties and extra vegetables to keep the meal more balanced.

cake.health_tip: Treat as a dessert portion and combine with lower-sugar meals through the day.

chole_bhature.health_tip: A smaller bhature portion with extra chole and onion salad improves satiety.

dhokla.health_tip: Dhokla is relatively light; pair it with chutney and a protein-rich side if needed.

dosa.health_tip: Use less oil and add sambar for a better protein and fiber profile.

fries.health_tip: Try baked or air-fried potatoes for a lighter version with less added fat.

idli.health_tip: Idli is a strong low-fat option; adding sambar improves fullness and protein.

jalebi.health_tip: Jalebi is sugar-dense, so keeping the serving small matters more than anything else.

pani_puri.health_tip: Use more filling and less sweet chutney to improve nutrition balance.

pav_bhaji.health_tip: Use extra vegetables and fewer buttered pavs to reduce calorie density.

pizza.health_tip: Thin crust and vegetable toppings improve the macro balance without losing flavor.

poha.health_tip: Add peanuts and sprouts to increase protein and satiety.

roll.health_tip: Prefer grilled fillings and less sauce to keep calories lower.

samosa.health_tip: Pair with high-fiber salad and avoid deep-fried sides in the same meal.

sandwich.health_tip: Use whole-grain bread and lean fillings for better nutrient density.

taco.health_tip: Choose grilled protein and extra veggies, and moderate high-fat toppings.

vada_pav.health_tip: Balance with a lighter next meal and include fresh vegetables when possible.

vadapav.health_tip: Balance with a lighter next meal and include fresh vegetables when possible.
